records.claim: Studies have not found a higher chance of birth defects in the children of men taking methotrexate around the time of conception. In general, exposures that men or sperm donors have are unlikely to increase risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes methotrexate, could it affect fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
